name: Photonic
description: Unlocks [color=#E9C820]Light Mode[/color]. You glow, lighting nearby players too. Light shots bounce twice, leaving a light at each bounce.

badge.name: Lumen Core
badge.description: Unlocks [color=#E9C820]Light Mode[/color]. You glow, lighting nearby players too. Light shots bounce twice, leaving a light at each bounce.

commons.name: Lumen Trail
commons.description: Sneak to see the path you walked.

commons.name: Clear Sight
commons.description: Night Vision. Immune to Blindness and Darkness.

adept.name: Flare
adept.description: Light projectiles reveal nearby entities through walls.

adept.name: Radiance
adept.description: Light shots heal you and nearby allies (doesn't stack).

master.name: Daybreak
master.description: Light shots scare darkness-loving mobs and burn them up close.

master.name: Mirage
master.description: Light shots leave a decoy of you where they end.

grandmaster.name: Constellation
grandmaster.description: Bounce lights link up, spreading their effects. Mirage leaves a decoy at each.

grandmaster.name: Supernova
grandmaster.description: The last impact releases one big Light pulse. Mirage decoys last longer.
